changelog:
- Initial release: Extracts comprehensive detail data from a single Goofish (闲鱼) item page given a URL or item ID.
- Outputs: title, price, seller info (name, labels), description, image gallery, item tags/attributes, and want-count.
- Includes pre-execution checks for browser tool readiness and authenticated Goofish login.
- Captures all detail fields displayed on the page and handles common errors including CAPTCHA and unavailable/removed items.
- Suitable for both single item lookups and bulk enrichment with batch-execution recommendations.
summary: Extracts full detail data from a single Goofish (闲鱼/xianyu, goofish.com) second-hand item page. Input: item URL or item ID. Output: title, price, seller info...
